_comment: R1 fixture spec, shared byte-for-byte with auros-base/matrix/run/lib/r1-fixture.spec.json. Each top-level directory is a copy-engine source Label. Names are chosen to exercise every encoding rule: percent, reserved device stem, trailing dot, a Sanitize-escaped byte, a wire-escaped control byte, raw byte-order sorting (U+FF21 sorts BEFORE an astral emoji in UTF-8 and AFTER it in UTF-16), a zero-byte file, and a second label.
